original_test_intent: Run the approved DirectX 12 Time Spy workload at actual 1920x1080 on a dedicated Windows GPU/display path, validate benchmark result and visible stability, and detect new ECC/platform errors.
original_method: Verify approved installer hash/license and exact v2.20.7274/Time Spy settings, confirm physical mode, capture baseline GPU/BMC/Windows health, run the bounded benchmark once or approved count, collect complete result/score/validity plus physical display evidence and compare ECC/events, then cool and restore the session.
manual_activity: Operator approves licensed installer/settings and watches the physical 1920x1080 display while the agent may launch the bounded benchmark and collect result, telemetry and event evidence after explicit confirmation.
required_inputs: Approved 3DMark v2.20.7274 and Time Spy license/source/hash
Time Spy preset, loops and 20-minute boundary
Expected score range and result-validity rule
ECC counter/source, baseline/delta and severity threshold
Dedicated maintenance window and explicit confirmation
safety_requirements: Do not download/install from the third-party URL without owner provenance approval
Do not benchmark an active production GPU
Capture rather than clear baseline logs
Stop on thermal/power limit, driver reset, hang, artifact or invalid score
Treat `ipmitool ... grep ecc` as a narrow clue, not complete ECC evidence
Do not auto-repeat a failed run
agent_execution_scope: Read-only inventory, mode, package/license and baseline checks
Present exact preset/run/thresholds for user confirmation
Launch only approved bounded Time Spy workload
Collect complete result/validity/score, GPU telemetry and BMC/Windows events
Correlate operator visual evidence and ECC deltas
Stop without verdict and package recovery state
engineer_actions: Approve score/ECC/visual criteria and stress window
Provide physical observer and independent recovery
Confirm exact display mode and cooling margin

command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, launch the pinned licensed 3DMark v2.20.7274 Time Spy preset at verified 1920x1080 for the approved run count; collect full result/validity and resolution proof plus GPU, BMC ECC/SEL/SDR and Windows events while an operator observes the physical display.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: DirectX 12, v2.20.7274 plus Time Spy, 1920x1080 identity and 15/20-minute metadata remain; no score, loop count or ECC threshold is invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: READY AFTER LICENSED PACKAGE, THRESHOLD AND STRESS APPROVAL
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind benchmark artifact, preset and display mode; compare pre/post health and ECC counters; retain complete result validity and physical scanout video for the single approved 1080p run.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds artifact provenance, exact mode/preset/result and health correlation while retaining the benchmark and operator visual step.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Time Spy can saturate GPU power/thermal capacity and hang the Windows display driver; a third-party installer introduces supply-chain and licensing risk.

project_override_considerations: Confirm licensed installer source/hash, exact Time Spy preset/run count, true 1920x1080 display settings, score validity/range, ECC source/delta/severity, visual threshold, thermal/power stops, window and recovery; do not clear logs.
expected_evidence: Approved installer/license/hash, Windows/DirectX/GPU/driver and physical display identity
Requested and actual 1920x1080 mode plus Time Spy preset/run metadata
Immutable complete 3DMark result, validity and score artifacts
Pre/post GPU thermal/power/driver, BMC ECC/SEL/SDR and Windows event comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and Procedure consistently describe a Windows DirectX 12 3DMark/Time Spy display-performance run with ECC follow-up. Criteria is incomplete, but does not contradict the operation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The benchmark, resolution and evidence domains are identifiable. License/source, preset, thresholds and approval are normal package/project prerequisites, so REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION applies rather than BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Retains the hybrid classification while binding the 1080p identity, untrusted installer/license, exact benchmark validity, physical pixels, ECC deltas, thermal limits and recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: Time Spy result validity, rendered framebuffer, physical scanout and platform health are distinct. A numeric score can be valid while the monitor artifacts, and an empty ECC grep can miss counters or new non-ECC faults. The run therefore needs four correlated evidence planes at the exact 1080p mode.
